Name: Location Furniture
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[color=#ffffff][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff]This mod adds functionality similar to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Maps#Farmhouse_interior]FarmHouseFurniture[/url] map property. It recognizes the map property [b]LocationFurniture[/b] with a value syntax similar to that of [b]FarmHouseFurniture[/b]:[/color]

[color=#ffffff][b]LocationFurniture [<furniture ID> <tile X> <tile Y> <rotations> <can move>][/b][/color]

[color=#ffffff]e.g.:[/color]

[color=#ffffff][b]720 27 64 1 false[/b][/color]

[color=#ffffff]The above will add a brown couch at 25,63 that is rotated one rotation and immovable.[/color]


[size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size]

The easiest way to use this mod is by creating a content patcher patch, e.g.:

[code]{
    "Format": "2.9.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditMap",
            "Target": "Maps/Town",
            "MapProperties": {
                "LocationFurniture": "720 27 64 1 false"
            }
        },
    ]
}[/code]

[b][size=5]Misc[/size][/b]

Thanks to sexyness for the idea.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
